note: Gate-checkable projection of the QA Checklist in ../../SKILL.md (authoritative). type=python checks are computable via genie_cookbook.py; type=manual require agent/render inspection.

GATE_1_configuration.text: Trademark verdict clean; title classified with evidence; locked title recorded verbatim
Title+subtitle <=150 chars, keyword early, recipe count stated, no brands/em dashes
Projected pages within deployment budget via governor formula
Palette pair AND full design fingerprint unique in catalog; recipe set fingerprinted, zero collisions

GATE_2_structure.text: Live auto-TOC lists every category (H1) and recipe (H2)
Preface 1 page; How to Use 1 page; copyright+disclaimer from template
IMG-00 embedded as finished full-page image, not a prompt/placeholder
Front matter unnumbered; numbering starts at Introduction

GATE_3_per_chapter.text: Divider (IMG-D-<cat>) full-bleed with centered title band; art wordless, no white margins
Exactly two recipes per page in the book's archetype; no recipe splits; archetypes not mixed
Every recipe carries IMG-Rnn, embedded, bordered, trim-safe; one locked photo style
Every method list restarts at 1; no carried-over/manual step numbers
Zero pork/alcohol or hidden carriers; zero reader-facing mention; no such imagery
Metric conversion on every quantity; F(C) temps; Per Serving ends with theme nutrient
Body 11pt Times New Roman; only primary/accent colors; body text black

GATE_4_release.text: Total pages within budget; render shows no overflow/blank/orphan/broken tables/displaced images
Locked title matches character-for-character across cover, title page, TOC, metadata, State Block
Conclusion 1.5 pages, four movements, honest-review request
Every meal-plan cell resolves to a book recipe; tables repeat headers, no split rows
IMG-00 + one divider per category + one per recipe, all embedded and trim-safe
Whole-book silent-exclusion re-scan and em-dash scan pass

Chapter dividers follow THIS book's locked opener archetype from the 9-option menu (9c); title arrangement matches; text sits on the image ONLY in the text-on-image archetype with a scrim and grayscale verification; archetype+arrangement does not repeat any catalog book (check the Design Log)

Recipe archetype is one of the twelve (A-L: compact two-column, full-width stacked, ingredient sidebar, magazine band, boxed card, centerline minimalist, icon-cue rail, photo banner, ledger, journal, two-tone split, plated focus), consistent through the book, two recipes per page with per-recipe photos; archetype+palette-family combination does not repeat any catalog cookbook (check the Design Log)
Divider imagery mode (photography vs illustrated recipe art) matches the locked fingerprint; art generated text-free; illustration style consistent within the book
